published_prior_art.cite: IglesiasAlonsoEtAl2025 Appendix B.2 changes the target latent mixture through a rank-deficient proxy channel, not an interior separator perturbation preserving an injective channel and every observed source cell.

IglesiasAlonsoEtAl2025 Theorem 1 gives the full-source-rank sufficient condition; ZhangLiMiaoTchetgen2023 Proposition 2.3 gives bridge-fiber functional uniqueness, not the stated compatible-SCM full-law converse.
IglesiasAlonsoEtAl2025 Assumption 1 requires rank(P(W|E,x)) at least the latent cardinality; the explicit deficient-source-rank witness is a useful strictness corollary of the new frontier.
IglesiasAlonsoEtAl2025 Proposition 5 supplies pointwise asymptotic Wald inference under full rank; DufourTaamouti2005 supplies AR projection methods for linear structural models.
AndrewsGuggenberger2019 Theorem 9.1 treats subvector tests on compact nuisance spaces with regularity and singular-value conditions, rather than this unrestricted two-multinomial balancing fiber.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 3 (finite-sample-projection-coverage)
soundness_flags.one_line: P_{\mathcal M} is defined as a one-draw source full-data law, but is used to measure a joint source/target-sample event; define the product sampling law P_O^{\otimes n_s}\otimes b^{\otimes n_t} and use it in the coverage probability.

soundness_flags.label: Open-ended Question 1 (studentized-uniform-projection)
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed fixed strongly identified submodel, its regular Wald interval, and the diameter metric are undefined, so the requested regular-branch reduction is not yet a determinate property.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 3--4, Assumption 1 and Theorem 1; p. 26, Appendix B.2
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Assumption 1 is rank(P(W|E,x)) at least the latent cardinality and Theorem 1 identifies q(y|do(x)) by the pseudoinverse formula; Appendix B.2's nonidentification example has rank(P(W|U))=2<3 and changes the target U law while holding observed laws fixed.
The subvector AR/CQLR result uses a compact nuisance parameter space and additional regularity, identifiability, covariance-invertibility, and minimum-Jacobian-singular-value restrictions.

The manuscript defines a full-rank distinguishing-environment mixture matrix over latent-equivalent classes and proves point identification of a target predictor; it is predictive rather than an interventional full-observed-law transport theorem.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define the nonindexed two-sample product law and use it consistently in the finite-sample coverage theorem; then define the regular branch by an explicit fixed-rank and positive minimum-singular-value condition, a named plug-in estimator, and Euclidean interval diameter.

Promote the separator construction into an explicit observable decision procedure: input (B_x,b), return either a balancing functional or h in the left null space and the specified outcome-slice perturbation certificate.

Obtain and cite the exact Statistics and Probability Letters version of Zhang et al. Proposition 2.3, then add a short proposition formally separating its bridge-fiber premise from the positive compatible-SCM realizability converse.

recommended_next_step: Repair the two well-posedness defects, preserve the target-span iff and full-law converse as the field-tier kernel, then advance to Stage 0.
